name: Clay Diorama 3D
description: Real 3D (three.js) miniature dioramas: soft pastel clay objects pop onto a rounded floating plinth, warm studio light with soft shadows and floating dust, a slow orbiting camera. Playful and tactile, like a stop-motion set. Two-tone headlines, word-pill captions, SFX on every pop and a ducked music bed. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 6-10 scenes (3-6 s each). Every scene has title.kicker + title.main and visual.type "scene3d" with 1-5 objects that literally show the idea (phone, laptop, server, database, cloud, document, coin, chart, lock, rocket, lightbulb, person, house, tree, icon...). One object = hero shot; 3-5 objects = a little world. Short object labels (1-3 words). Use connect for flows. Never use emoji.
